about_the_game:
Exciting Puzzle: Face creative and diverse puzzle challenges along the way. Use your wits to overcome dangerous traps and obstacles.

Large Number of Themes and Maps: Explore many unique and attractive themes, each theme comes with many maps for you to challenge.

Levels Get Harder Than Levels: Each level becomes more difficult, requiring your patience and skill to pass. Adjust the difficulty to your preference and challenge yourself each time you play.

Fixed Moving Camera: Experience a new feeling with a fixed moving camera in the screen, helping you focus more on your adventure without losing focus.

Perfect Graphics and Music: Enjoy sharp graphics and catchy music throughout your journey, creating an amazing visual and auditory experience.

Let's embark on a never-ending journey together in Dino Run Puzzle and discover the wonders of the dinosaur world!
